name: dev8
description: Eight representative cases used during development. Cheap enough to run after every candidate; broad enough that a win here is unlikely to be a fluke. Promote nothing on dev8 alone -- re-run bench/shapes/official.json before recording a headline number.

cases.name: default
cases.note: The script's own defaults. 1024 tokens, ~19M params, ~90 kernel launches per forward. Launch-bound, not compute-bound.

cases.name: default-bf16
cases.note: Same shape, reduced precision. Checks that the tolerance budget survives bf16.

cases.name: default-fp16
cases.note: Same shape, fp16. Narrower dynamic range than bf16, wider mantissa.

cases.name: causal
cases.note: Causal masking on. The baseline rebuilds the triangular mask once per layer.

cases.name: padded
cases.note: Padding on. Three masked_fill sites become live; a naive SDPA swap silently fails here.

cases.name: long-seq
cases.note: Attention becomes O(S^2)-dominant. Different bottleneck from the default.

cases.name: wide-batch
cases.note: Same token count, more parallelism, shorter attention.

cases.name: deep-wide
cases.note: Compute-bound end of the grid. Where matmul quality starts to matter more than launch count.
